description: Na₂NiPO₄F crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.81 Å. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.42 Å. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.54 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.79 Å. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Na-F bond length. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.41 Å. There is one shorter (2.30 Å) and one longer (2.55 Å) Na-F bond length. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted NiO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NiO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and one longer (2.08 Å) Ni-O bond length. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and one longer (2.08 Å) Ni-F bond length. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to four O and two F atoms to form distorted NiO₄F₂ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NiO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one NiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.08 Å. There is one shorter (2.01 Å) and one longer (2.09 Å) Ni-F bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂NiP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Ni₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-76°. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂NiP tetrahedra that share corners with six FNa₄Ni₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-75°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to four Na and two Ni atoms to form FNa₄Ni₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂NiP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Ni₂ octahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to four Na and two Ni atoms to form distorted FNa₄Ni₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂NiP tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent FNa₄Ni₂ octahedra.
